items.title: Issue associations accepted foreign workspace targets

items.title: Public feedback accepted private program ids

items.title: Activity exposed private entity existence

items.title: Team allocation writes were member-wide

items.title: Week lifecycle mutations used visibility as authority
items.note: Start and carryover could bypass the stricter approval authority model.

items.title: Debug user delete was non-transactional

items.note: Contract claimed full document search before route capability existed.

items.note: Route parity needed generated checks instead of trusting artifact size.

items.title: API coverage gate was only a changed-file heuristic

items.title: Root lint was a no-op placeholder
items.note: Green lint output did not mean the repo had been linted.

items.title: API test setup could erase real data
items.note: Database safety depended on disposable test DB discipline.

items.title: Compare broad E2E failures against clean master
items.note: Dependency branches should not overclaim existing suite debt as regressions.
